title: Chapter 6 I Will Never Be Afraid Of The Cold Again
content:
Chapter 6 I Will Never Be Afraid Of The Cold Again

After a while, Lu Daosheng returned to the palace of the Lord of the Wilderness City.

"These should be enough for Xiaoxue to awaken her physique and bloodline."

Lu Daosheng nodded and then began to prepare.

First, we must first create the innate mysterious ice jade obtained from the system store.

I saw a huge piece of innate mysterious ice jade appearing directly in front of Lu Daosheng, which was even bigger than Lu Daosheng.

Innate Xuan Ice Jade is an extremely precious raw material for ice-based magic weapons.

Generally, if a piece of innate mysterious ice jade the size of a little finger can be added to some ice-type magic weapon, the power of this magic weapon will surge in a large proportion.

Therefore, when creating ice-type magic weapons, the innate Xuan Ice Jade master is the auxiliary material. After all, it is very rare, and there are not so many materials to use as the main material.

And now, Lu Daosheng is even bigger than a human being.

This is because Lu Daosheng only bought one from the system store. If he bought a little more, he would probably have no problem using it to build a city.

At this time, Lu Daosheng began to take action.

When others create magic weapons and weapons, they will use a forging furnace, while Lu Daosheng directly uses his hands, not even a hammer.

As Lu Daosheng gradually exerted his strength, the huge piece of innate mysterious ice jade began to change.

Buzzing-

A moment later, a large jar appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

That's right, Lu Daosheng used this innate mysterious ice jade to create a big vat.

"Well, it's not bad, but it seems like something is almost there."

Then Lu Daosheng waved his lightly, and a stream of spiritual wisdom was born from the large barrel of Xuanbing Jade.

Pull the spirit with bare hands!

boom!

In an instant, a cold breath gushed out of the barrel.

At the same time, the temperature in the entire wasteland city inexplicably dropped a little.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng quickly waved his hand to block the breath.

After touching the large vat made of the innate Xuan Ice Jade, Lu Daosheng nodded with satisfaction.

"Xiaoxue will take this for a bath, it will be very comfortable."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng took out the hundreds of bottles of fortune nectar and poured them all into it.

Soon the vat was filled with the nectar of fortune.

At this time, in a room full of girlish aura in the city lord's mansion, Lu Xue was sitting cross-legged in practicing, and Lu Daosheng's voice suddenly sounded in his mind.

"Xiaoxue, come here."

"father?"

Lu Xue opened her eyes in surprise and looked around.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue headed towards Lu Daosheng's room.

In Lu Daosheng's room.

A squeak.

"Dad, are you looking for me?"

Lu Xue pushed the door and immediately felt a bone-broken chill.

Looking at the bathtub in front of him, Lu Xue was stunned.

"Dad, where did you find such a strange bathtub?"

On the side, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and said, "Xiaoxue, this is what dad prepared for you. Take off your clothes and go in."

Hearing this, Lu Xue looked a little confused.

"Dad, do you ask me to take a bath?"

Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Xiaoxue, your talent is not low. This can activate the talent in your body. At that time, your cultivation speed will be greatly improved."

Hearing this, Lu Xue's expression lit up.

"Really, that's great."

But then Lu Xue lowered her head again.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng paused in his heart, "Xiaoxue, what's wrong."

Lu Xue slowly said, "Dad, are you hiding something from me?"

During this period, Lu Daosheng has changed a lot.

As a daughter, how could she not be able to see it?

Something must have happened to my dad.

But now, my father is hiding it from her, which makes her very uncomfortable.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Lu Daosheng was stunned, was silent for a moment, and said, "Xiaoxue, there are some things that my father really didn't tell you."

"Let's do it like this. You can take a bath first. After you finish taking a bath, you will activate the talent in your body. Dad will tell you."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue nodded and said, "Okay, dad, this is what you said, don't lie to me."

"Of course, when did Dad deceive you?"

Then Lu Daosheng instructed him not to leave the Xuanbing Jade Bucket, but to go out directly and wait outside the door.

He must have to stay by Lu Xue's side, but his daughter is so old, so he naturally can't stay by the side when taking a shower.

But through a door, whether it is the same for a strong man like him.

After a while, Lu Xue entered the Xuanbing Jade Bucket with a pounce.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng outside the door began to activate the Xuanbing Jade Bucket.

Sensing Lu Daosheng's order, a creepy coldness suddenly came from the Bing Xuan Jade Bucket.

At this time, Lu Xue, who had just entered the Xuanbing Jade Bucket, her expression changed drastically. The nectar of fortune began to constantly bombard her body. Following her skin, the unimaginable energy rushed into her directly. inside the body.

A drop of fortune can even change a person's destiny.

Once taken, it will greatly improve the physical talent of the taker.

And now, Lu Xue uses the nectar of fortune to take a bath.

If the strong outsiders learned about it, they would probably be so angry that they vomited blood.

Feeling the unusualness in his body, Lu Xue immediately sat cross-legged on the ground in a hurry, frantically suppressing the riot inside her body.

But even so, Lu Xue's cultivation began to rise wildly.

The sixth level of Qi Refining Period.

The seventh level of Qi Refining Period.

The eighth level of Qi Refining Period.

......

Until Lu Xue broke through to the innate realm without any effort, Lu Xue's cultivation level did not stop.

Finally, Lu Xue's cultivation reached the peak of the spiritual master realm.

Before she could react, Lu Xue felt something unusual again.

Cold, very cold, very cold.

In theory, practitioners are generally not afraid of cold, not to mention that she is already in the spiritual master realm, but now, she is shivering from the cold.

"Dad!"

Feeling the temperature getting lower and lower, Lu Xue finally couldn't help but called Dad.

Outside the door, looking at his daughter's painful expression, Lu Daosheng was heartbroken, but still said: "Xiaoxue, hold on, as long as you hold on, you won't be afraid of cold in the future."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Lu Xue nodded, but her expression was still painful, and her whole body was shivering.

The bone-chilling coldness continued to invade Lu Xue's whole body.

"I, I can't do it, Dad, I really can't do it,"

I saw Lu Xue's mouth was cold, and the tears in her eyes flowed to her cheeks and turned directly into ice crystals, and she was trembling all over.

Seeing Lu Xue like this, Lu Daosheng's heart was about to break.

He, who usually loves his daughter very much, couldn't bear to watch it, and immediately pushed the door to pick up Lu Xue.

And at this moment, a figure appeared in front of him and blocked his way.

"City Lord!"

Gu Chen stood in front of Lu Daosheng, looking at Lu Daosheng and said.

"City Lord, Lu Xue will be fine. The reason for this is that her physique has entered the critical moment of awakening. If you give up now, she will never awaken again in the future. Do you want to protect her for life?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng calmed down immediately.

He knew all this, but as a father, how could he bear to see his daughter in pain.

At most, protect her for life.

Can't I do it now?

And at this moment, Lu Xue in the house spoke again.

"Dad, I, I will bear with it. I, I can, I can do it."

She also heard what Gu Chen said. It must not be easy for Dad to prepare these things. She can't live up to Dad's expectations.

It's just cold. At worst, she will freeze to death.

Looking at Lu Xue's sensible appearance, Lu Daosheng's eyes were slightly red, and he said to himself: "She is worthy of being my daughter, Lu Daosheng."

Then he turned his head away and stopped looking.

As if he thought of something, Lu Daosheng pulled Gu Chen to his side.
